## Run summary

```{r index-methods, results='asis'}
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Reproduce this report with the package entry point:",
  "library(deseq2reports)",
  "out <- run_deseq2_pipeline(",
  "  dds, var = \"condition\",",
  "  run_wgcna = TRUE, run_decoupler = TRUE, run_viper = TRUE,",
  "  run_ppi = TRUE, save_dir = \"results\"",
  ")"
)
```

```{r summary-table}
vdj_label <- if (!is.null(params$qc_out$remove_vdj) && length(params$qc_out$remove_vdj)) {
  paste(params$qc_out$remove_vdj, collapse = "+")
} else if (!is.null(params$run_args$remove_vdj) &&
           !is.null(params$run_args$remove_vdj) &&
           !isFALSE(params$run_args$remove_vdj) &&
           !(is.character(params$run_args$remove_vdj) && !length(params$run_args$remove_vdj))) {
  paste(as.character(params$run_args$remove_vdj), collapse = "+")
} else {
  "none"
}

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Field = c("Grouping variable", "Design formula", "Organism", "Samples", "Genes (post-QC)",
            "Significance threshold (alpha)", "LFC threshold", "VDJ gene removal",
            "deseq2reports version"),
  Value = c(paste(params$var, collapse = ", "), params$design_str, params$org,
            as.character(params$n_samples), as.character(params$n_genes),
            as.character(params$alpha), as.character(params$lfc_threshold),
            vdj_label, as.character(params$package_version))
)
knitr::kable(summary_df)
```

```{r contrast-inventory, results='asis'}
specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
if (!is.null(specs) && nrow(specs) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n## Contrasts\n\n")
  cat(nrow(specs), " contrast(s) in this run:\n\n", sep = "")
  inv <- specs[, intersect(c("label", "class", "type", "stratum_level", "comparison"),
                           colnames(specs)), drop = FALSE]
  print(knitr::kable(inv, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r run-args, results='asis'}if (!is.null(params$run_args) && length(params$run_args)) {
  cat("\n\n## Pipeline arguments\n\n")
  cat("Arguments passed to `run_deseq2_pipeline()` for this run:\n\n")
  args <- params$run_args
  fmt <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return("NULL")
    if (is.logical(x) && length(x) == 1) return(as.character(x))
    if (is.numeric(x) && length(x) == 1) return(as.character(x))
    if (is.character(x)) return(paste(x, collapse = ", "))
    paste(deparse(x), collapse = " ")
  }
  args_df <- data.frame(
    Argument = names(args),
    Value = vapply(args, fmt, character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print(knitr::kable(args_df, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Report sections

```{r section-links, results='asis'}
hrefs <- params$page_hrefs
if (is.null(hrefs)) hrefs <- deseq2reports::report_page_hrefs(params$current_page)
cat("\n\nThis report is split across the following linked pages (each module's HTML ",
    "lives in its own folder; every page is fully self-contained and viewable offline):\n\n", sep = "")
cat("\n\n- [**QC**](", hrefs[["QC"]], ") -- library QC, PCA, and sample-similarity heatmap\n", sep = "")
cat("- [**DESeq2**](", hrefs[["DESeq2"]],
    ") -- per-comparison MA plot, volcano plot, DEG table",
    if (!is.null(params$ppi_out)) ", and PPI connectivity" else "",
    "\n", sep = "")
cat("- [**clusterProfiler**](", hrefs[["clusterProfiler"]],
    ") -- per-comparison, per-collection GSEA barplot, gene-enrichment barcode, and results table",
    if (!is.null(params$gsea_overlap_out)) {
      ", plus leading-edge Jaccard overlap (binary-cut clusters + word clouds)"
    } else {
      ""
    },
    "\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(params$wgcna_out)) {
  cat("- [**WGCNA**](", hrefs[["WGCNA"]],
      ") -- co-expression modules, module-trait/eigengene heatmaps, per-module pathway enrichment",
      if (!is.null(params$ppi_out) && length(params$ppi_out$by_module)) {
        ", and module PPI connectivity"
      } else {
        ""
      },
      "\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- WGCNA -- not run for this report (`wgcna_out = NULL`)\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$decoupler_out)) {
  cat("- [**decoupleR**](", hrefs[["decoupleR"]],
      ") -- CollecTRI network + ULM transcription-factor activities\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- decoupleR -- not run for this report (`decoupler_out = NULL`)\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$viper_out)) {
  cat("- [**VIPER**](", hrefs[["VIPER"]],
      ") -- bcellViper regulon + VIPER / msVIPER protein-activity inference\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- VIPER -- not run for this report (`viper_out = NULL`)\n")
}
cat("\n\n")
```

## Cross-analysis gene hits

```{r multihit-setup, include=FALSE}
is_lrt_mh <- identical(params$multihit_out$mode, "lrt_module") ||
  isTRUE(params$run_args$analysis_mode == "lrt")
has_lrt_mh <- is_lrt_mh && !is.null(params$multihit_out$by_module) &&
  length(params$multihit_out$by_module) > 0
has_wald_mh <- !is_lrt_mh && !is.null(params$multihit_out$by_comparison) &&
  length(params$multihit_out$by_comparison) > 0
```

```{r multihit-intro, results='asis'}
mh <- params$multihit_out
if (has_lrt_mh) {
  layers <- paste(mh$layers_used, collapse = ", ")
  cat("\n\nTop **", mh$top_n, "** genes per **degPatterns cluster**, ranked by ",
      "co-occurrence across ", layers,
      " (LRT DEG = cluster membership; WGCNA = any co-expression module; ",
      "VIPER / decoupleR = significant TF at alpha = ", mh$alpha, "). ",
      "Tables only (no directional barplots in LRT mode).\n\n", sep = "")
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce LRT multi-hit ranking with this package module:",
    "multihit_out <- run_multihit_lrt_pipeline(",
    "  degpatterns_out, diffexp_out,",
    "  wgcna_out = wgcna_out,",
    "  viper_out = viper_out, decoupler_out = decoupler_out",
    ")"
  )
} else if (has_wald_mh) {
  layers <- paste(mh$layers_used, collapse = ", ")
  cat("\n\nTop ", mh$top_n, " **up** and top ", mh$top_n,
      " **down** genes per contrast (direction from DEG log2FoldChange), ",
      "ranked by hit count across ", layers,
      " (GSEA contributes +1 if the gene is in **any** significant ",
      "pathway leading edge; DEG / VIPER / decoupleR / CSPA contribute +1 ",
      "when selected or significant at alpha = ", mh$alpha, ").\n\n", sep = "")
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce multi-hit ranking with this package module:",
    "multihit_out <- run_multihit_pipeline(",
    "  diffexp_out, gsea_out = gsea_out,",
    "  viper_out = viper_out, decoupler_out = decoupler_out,",
    "  cspa_out = cspa_out",
    ")"
  )
} else {
  cat("\n\nMulti-hit gene ranking was not available for this run.\n\n")
}
```

```{r multihit-lrt-tables, results='asis', eval=has_lrt_mh}
by_mod <- params$multihit_out$by_module
mods <- names(by_mod)
short_labs <- sub("^.* cluster ", "cluster ", mods)
if (anyDuplicated(short_labs) || any(!nzchar(short_labs))) {
  short_labs <- mods
}
pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start("index-lrt-multihit", short_labs)
for (i in seq_along(mods)) {
  mod <- mods[i]
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(pane_ids[i], active = (i == 1L))
  ranked <- by_mod[[mod]]
  if (is.null(ranked) || !nrow(ranked)) {
    cat("\n\nNo genes scored for this cluster.\n\n")
  } else {
    show <- ranked
    # Present hit columns as 0/1 for readability
    for (col in intersect(c("deg", "wgcna", "viper", "decoupler"), colnames(show))) {
      show[[col]] <- as.integer(show[[col]])
    }
    print(knitr::kable(show, row.names = FALSE))
    safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", mod)
    deseq2reports::emit_widget(
      deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path("multihit", safe, paste0(safe, "_top_genes.csv")),
        label = "Download top genes CSV"
      )
    )
  }
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
}
deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
```

```{r multihit-helpers, include=FALSE}
emit_multihit_contrast <- function(comp, ranked, plot) {
  if (is.null(ranked) || !nrow(ranked)) {
    cat("\n\nNo genes scored for this contrast.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (!is.null(plot)) {
    sz <- attr(plot, "plot_size")
    w <- if (!is.null(sz)) sz$width else 4.9
    h <- if (!is.null(sz)) sz$height else max(2.8, 0.2 * nrow(ranked) + 1.5)
    deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
      plot, filename = paste0(comp, "_multihit_barplot"),
      width = w, height = h, dpi = 150
    )
  }
  deseq2reports::emit_widget(
    deseq2reports::link_output_file(
      file.path("multihit", comp, paste0(comp, "_top_genes.csv")),
      label = "Download top genes CSV"
    )
  )
  cat("\n\n")
}

specs_mh <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
if (is.null(specs_mh) && has_wald_mh) {
  labs <- names(params$multihit_out$by_comparison)
  specs_mh <- data.frame(
    label = labs, class = "single",
    type = deseq2reports::classify_comparison_type(labs),
    stratum_level = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
two_factor_mh <- !is.null(specs_mh) &&
  any(specs_mh$class %in% c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction"))
by_mh <- if (has_wald_mh) params$multihit_out$by_comparison else list()
plots_mh <- if (has_wald_mh) params$multihit_out$plots else list()
```

```{r multihit-single, results='asis', eval=has_wald_mh && !two_factor_mh}
de_pairwise <- specs_mh$label[specs_mh$type == "pairwise"]
de_one_vs_all <- specs_mh$label[specs_mh$type == "one_vs_all"]

cat("\n\n### Pairwise {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(de_pairwise) > 0) {
  for (comp in de_pairwise) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo pairwise comparisons.\n\n")
}

cat("\n\n### One vs. all {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(de_one_vs_all) > 0) {
  for (comp in de_one_vs_all) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo one-vs-all comparisons.\n\n")
}
```

```{r multihit-two-factor, results='asis', eval=has_wald_mh && two_factor_mh}
var <- params$var
for (cls in c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction")) {
  sub <- specs_mh[specs_mh$class == cls, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  title <- deseq2reports::contrast_class_title(cls, var)
  cat("\n\n### ", title, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")

  if (identical(cls, "interaction")) {
    has_sub <- "coef_subtract" %in% names(sub)
    is_pw <- if (has_sub) {
      !is.na(sub$coef_subtract) & nzchar(as.character(sub$coef_subtract))
    } else {
      rep(FALSE, nrow(sub))
    }
    ref_labs <- sub$label[!is_pw]
    pw_labs <- sub$label[is_pw]
    if (length(ref_labs) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n#### Vs reference {.tabset}\n\n")
      for (comp in ref_labs) {
        cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
      }
    }
    if (length(pw_labs) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n#### Pairwise (non-reference) {.tabset}\n\n")
      for (comp in pw_labs) {
        cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
      }
    }
    next
  }

  strata <- unique(sub$stratum_level)
  for (st in strata) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", st, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
    st_sub <- sub[sub$stratum_level == st, , drop = FALSE]
    ordered <- c(st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "pairwise"],
                 st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "one_vs_all"])
    for (comp in ordered) {
      cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
      emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
    }
  }
}
```
